SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.dispatch_seq AS "dispatchSeq" , A.office_seq AS "officeSeq" , A.category AS "category" , A.category AS "ioDiv" , A.doc_type AS "docType" , A.dispatch_date AS "dispatchDate" , A.client AS "client" , A.client AS "contractor" , A.manager AS "manager" , A.doc_content AS "docContent" , A.method AS "method" , A.method AS "sendMethod" , A.send_date AS "sendDate" , A.reg_no AS "regNo" , A.reg_no AS "postNo" , A.ack_yn AS "ackYn" , A.post_addr AS "postAddr" , A.note AS "note" , A.del_yn AS "delYn" , A.create_user AS "createUser" , A.create_at AS "createAt" , A.update_user AS "updateUser" , A.update_at AS "updateAt" , B.user_name_ko AS "uploadUserName" FROM utb_doc_dispatch A LEFT JOIN utb_user_info B ON A.create_user = B.user_info_seq WHERE A.office_seq = #{request.officeSeq} AND A.del_yn = 'N' ) Z WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY Z."createAt" DESC LIMIT #{request.pageSize} OFFSET #{request.offSet}
